description: This file provides a deprecated wrapper around the standard library's context package, re-exporting types, variables, and functions for backward compatibility in Go projects.

methods.name: Background
methods.description: Returns a non-nil, empty Context used as the top-level context.

methods.name: TODO
methods.description: Returns a non-nil, empty Context used when the specific context is not yet available.

methods.name: WithCancel
methods.description: Creates a derived context with a new Done channel that can be canceled.

methods.name: WithDeadline
methods.description: Creates a derived context with a specified deadline.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: Creates a derived context with a timeout, equivalent to WithDeadline with a time relative to now.

methods.name: WithValue
methods.description: Creates a derived context with an associated key-value pair for request-scoped data.
